assertions.assertion: Implements IResourceValidator with method ValidateRequestedResourcesAsync taking ResourceValidationRequest and a CancellationToken
assertions.rationale: Method signature takes only ResourceValidationRequest, no CancellationToken.

assertions.assertion: Notes that the CancellationToken parameter was added in v8
assertions.rationale: No mention of CancellationToken being added in v8; says unsure of v8 members.

assertions.assertion: Registers the validator via AddResourceValidator<T>() on the IdentityServer builder
assertions.rationale: Does not use AddResourceValidator<T>(); manual AddTransient<IResourceValidator> factory instead (and says AddResourceValidator replaces).

assertions.assertion: When wrapping/decorating the default, also registers services.AddTransient<DefaultResourceValidator>()
References ResourceValidationRequest members such as Client, Scopes, and ResourceIndicators (RFC 8707)
assertions.rationale: Does not reference Client, Scopes or ResourceIndicators members of the request.
